references.label: Bumblebee captive ball
references.description: The captive ball is on the left-center side beside the left ramp.

references.label: Cassette target
references.description: Roll through the left inlane to light the Cassette target, then chain the right ramp, left ramp, and Cassette target.

references.label: Energon spinner
references.description: The center spinner is just right of the main lock VUK.

references.label: drop targets
references.description: Shoot Megatron's scoop to start it; knock down drop targets only as needed to reach the scoop.

references.label: left inlane
references.description: Clear Megatron's drops, roll through the lit right inlane twice without using the lit left inlane, and shoot the right orbit to start Starscream Frenzy.

references.label: left ramp
references.description: Fast shots in the spinner, left ramp, right orbit, left orbit, and side-ramp sequence score 3x.

references.label: Megatron scoop
references.description: The Megatron scoop is behind the three drop targets in the upper-right-center area.

references.label: Megatron's scoop
references.description: Shoot Megatron's scoop to start it; knock down drop targets only as needed to reach the scoop.

references.label: Optimus target
references.description: The Optimus target is below the figure on the upper-left-center side.

references.label: Optimus and VUK
references.description: Follow its five blue arrows while taking incidental Optimus and VUK lock progress.

references.label: right inlane
references.description: Clear Megatron's drops, roll through the lit right inlane twice without using the lit left inlane, and shoot the right orbit to start Starscream Frenzy.

references.label: right orbit
references.description: Fast shots in the spinner, left ramp, right orbit, left orbit, and side-ramp sequence score 3x.

references.label: Right ramp
references.description: The steep right ramp starts on the right side below Megatron.

references.label: Side ramp
references.description: The steep upper-flipper ramp rises beside Optimus in the upper-left-center area.

references.label: Transformers lock VUK
references.description: The lock VUK is the center scoop between Optimus and the spinner.
